name: Qwen / Model Studio
billing: Model Studio bills by model and region. Verify the applicable quota, payment method and pay-as-you-go price before making a request.

regions.name: Singapore (international)
regions.note: The installed Prism default URL targets the international endpoint. Use a key and model from the matching region.

regions.name: Other regions
regions.note: Keys, endpoints and model lists cannot be mixed across regions. Set the matching provider URL in your own application.

steps: Sign in to Alibaba Cloud and activate Model Studio in the region you plan to use.
In the Model Studio API Key page, select that region, choose Create API Key and select the appropriate workspace and owner.
Copy the newly created key into your own secret storage. Keep the key, model and service endpoint in the same region; do not substitute a Coding Plan key for a pay-as-you-go key.
